items.name: graphite
items.title: Graphite Instrument
items.description: A tactile light and dark theme for shadcn/ui. Raised panels, recessed wells, and quiet controls.

:is(:is(\n [data-slot=\"button\"],\n b.transition:
border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    scale calc(var(--transition-duration, 140ms) * 0.714286) ease-out

[data-slot=\"tabs-trigger\"].transition:
background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

:is([data-slot=\"checkbox\"], [data-slot.transition:
border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

[data-slot=\"switch\"].transition:
background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    border-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

[data-slot=\"switch-thumb\"].transition:
translate var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

:is([data-slot=\"sidebar-menu-button\"],.transition:
background-color var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out,
    box-shadow var(--transition-duration, 140ms) ease-out

.status-led.box-shadow:
0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 45%, transparent),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 22%, transparent)

.status-led[data-status=\"warning\"].box-shadow:
0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 45%, transparent),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 22%, transparent)
